title: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService
responsibility: Project committed task attempts and reviews into idempotent model, token, API price and bounce analytics.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.constructor.store
inputs.description: Factory for a synchronous or promised analytics store; defaults to the asynchronous AnalyticsRepository.open factory.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.quote.model
inputs.description: Model identifier used to select the existing local task pricing rates.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.quote.usage
inputs.description: Reported token usage; missing counts remain unknown in the resulting estimate.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.metrics.events
inputs.description: Analytics events to deduplicate and summarize; only task events with module-task details contribute.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.sync.root
inputs.description: Project root whose persisted module-task queue is reconciled into analytics.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.quote
outputs.description: Locally estimated task cost and range from the current taskPricing helper; this is not an authoritative billing meter.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.metrics
outputs.description: Task, execution, submission and review counters with token/cost totals and per-model groups; incomplete usage and costs remain null.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskAnalyticsService.sync
outputs.description: Number of imported events; returns zero when disabled, empty, or after a caught storage/queue failure and warning.
